title: Pipelines and Generation
summary: This module provides high-level, task-specific abstractions (pipelines) for common machine learning tasks and the underlying core generation logic for models. It enables efficient and flexible model inference and text generation.

nodes.label: Task-Specific Pipelines
nodes.title: Task-Specific Pipelines
nodes.description: High-level, user-friendly interfaces for common machine learning tasks like ASR, DQA, and Image-to-Text generation, handling end-to-end workflows.

nodes.label: Core Generation Logic
nodes.title: Core Generation Logic
nodes.description: Provides the fundamental mechanisms for text generation, including various decoding strategies (greedy, beam search, sampling) and continuous batching for efficiency.

nodes.label: Model Architectures
nodes.title: Model Architectures Module
nodes.description: Contains the definitions and implementations of various pre-trained models used by pipelines and the generation core for inference.

nodes.label: Data Processing
nodes.title: Data Processing Module
nodes.description: Handles the preprocessing of raw input data (text, audio, images) into model-ready features, utilized by the pipelines.

nodes.label: User Input
nodes.title: Raw User Input
nodes.description: The initial raw data provided by the user, such as text prompts, audio files, or document images, for processing by the pipelines.

nodes.label: Generated Output
nodes.title: Task-Specific Results
nodes.description: The final results produced by the pipelines or generation core, such as transcribed text, QA answers, or generated text sequences.

groups.label: User Interface Layer
groups.title: User Interaction & Abstraction
groups.description: This group represents the entry point for users, where raw inputs are provided and high-level task pipelines abstract complex ML workflows.

groups.label: Core Functionality
groups.title: Core Generation Engine
groups.description: This group encapsulates the fundamental logic and algorithms responsible for generating sequences, including various decoding strategies and performance optimizations.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: Supporting Modules
groups.description: This group highlights the essential external modules that provide models and data preprocessing capabilities, which are crucial for the pipelines and generation core to operate.

groups.label: Output Delivery
groups.title: Result Delivery
groups.description: This group represents the final stage where the processed and generated results are delivered back to the user or downstream systems.
